text:
Lina (Marketing): Quick sync — BridgeCloud is greenlit for a co-marketing push. Suggestion: 3-part demo series (live + on-demand), a benchmarks blog comparing latency/cost on their marketplace vs self-host, and a joint webinar. Goal: generate MQLs and marketplace listings traffic. Thoughts? :rocket:
Sam (Sales): love the cadence. On leads — need clear routing and attribution so our SDRs get credit. Can we push leads into SF with a partner tag + utm_medium=bridgecloud?
Devon (Partnerships): Partner wants joint webinar 2nd week of May. They asked for a 30-min product demo + 15-min panel w/ a customer. Also want marketplace banner on launch week. They want collateral by Apr 18.
Mia (Content): I'll draft the benchmark narrative. Outline: 1) test setup & config (models, sequence lengths), 2) cost-per-1k tokens by batch strategy, 3) latency p50/p95, 4) recommended configs for BridgeCloud users. Will need runtime logs + sample prompts from ENG.
Priya (Growth): For inbound routing — propose form on joint landing page that posts to our webhook and includes a partner_id param. Quick mapping: partner_id=bridgecloud -> queue=partner-webinar -> owner_pool=sd-bridge. Also add utm params for attribution.
Sam (Sales): that mapping works. Can we also add a simple qualifying question: "What are you building with LLMs?" (choices: Prod, PoC, Research). Helps triage.
Lina (Marketing): Good call. Mia, can you own the landing copy + webinar outline? Devon, can you secure the customer speaker and confirm the banner asset specs? Priya, please create the lead mapping snippet and QA with sales.
Mia (Content): Yep. Draft due Apr 12. Will ping ENG for token samples and perf logs.
Devon (Partnerships): I'll confirm speaker by Apr 8 and get banner 1200x628.
Priya (Growth): Here's the minimal routing snippet I'll hand to eng (pseudo):
```
POST /webhooks/partner-lead
payload: {
  "email": "...",
  "utm_source": "bridgecloud",
  "partner_id": "bridgecloud",
  "answers": {"use_case": "Prod"}
}
route -> if partner_id=="bridgecloud" then tag=partner_bridgecloud; queue=partner-webinar
```
Sam (Sales): can we add an SF custom field "Partner Source" so we can report on pipeline?
Lina (Marketing): Yes — set to BridgeCloud. Priya, add to mapping. Mia, we'll include a CTA in the benchmarks blog linking to the joint landing page.
Devon (Partnerships): FYI partner marketing wants co-branded social tiles and an optional joint case study later. Good op to drive marketplace listing clicks.
Mia (Content): Noted — I'll create a social tile kit (3 sizes) + blog hero variations.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "BridgeCloud co-marketing kickoff" Apr 3 10:00 AM PT — attendees: Lina, Devon, Mia, Priya, Sam.
Lina (Marketing): Action list: 1) Devon: speaker & banner by Apr 8; 2) Mia: drafts by Apr 12; 3) Priya: webhook mapping + SF field by Apr 10; 4) Sam: help define qualifying answers. I'll draft PRD for the series today and link in the kickoff. :thumbsup:
Sam (Sales): I'll draft the 3 qualifying options and add to the doc.
Priya (Growth): I'll spin up a Notion page and add the routing snippet + tracking spec: https://notion.so/redwood/bridgecloud-co-marketing (placeholder).
Lina (Marketing): Perfect — see you on the kickoff. If anything blocks, ping here. :handshake:
